name: tdd
description: Build features or fix bugs with red-green-refactor. Test-first, behavior-driven, no shortcuts.

steps.name: Plan
steps.instruction: Read project context + ADRs in touched area. Confirm behavior list and interface design with user. Read slice test annotations (facets, layers, permutations). If missing, enumerate as failsafe per test-selection.json.
checklist: Behavior list and interface confirmed with user
Slice test annotations read or failsafe-enumerated

steps.name: Endpoint scope check
steps.instruction: Verify slice covers every 'in' endpoint per registry. Read issue tracker if issue exists for this slice.
checklist: Every 'in' endpoint for this slice covered

steps.name: Tracer bullet
steps.instruction: Write one E2E test exercising happy path through public interface. Must fail (red).
checklist: E2E happy-path test written and failing

steps.name: Incremental loop
steps.instruction: Per behavior: failing test (red), minimal implementation (green), refactor. Show user each test before implementing. Same failure without new evidence = leave patch loop per routing-policy rerouting. When writing code that enforces an invariant, constraint, or business rule, add a single-line comment at the relevant code line. Format: # Invariant: <desc> | # Constraint: <desc> | # Rule: <desc> | # Correction: <desc>. These comments replace external documentation - they are the source of truth.
per_cycle_checklist: Test describes behavior via public interface, survives refactor
Code minimal for this test, no speculative features
Persistent failures escalated per loop budget

steps.name: Refactor
steps.instruction: Clean up implementation and tests per reference docs. Write slice done marker if complete (reference/slice-marker.md).
checklist: Interfaces deep, duplication eliminated, no test smells
Tests use cheapest falsifying layer, no circular oracles
Slice done marker written if complete

steps.name: Convention enforcement
steps.instruction: Verify convention-enforcement tests pass. Offer new convention test if repeating pattern emerged.
checklist: New convention test offered if pattern detected

tone: Disciplined. One test, one implementation, no shortcuts.
